outcome: Maternal morbidities (massive haemorrhage, intensive care unit admission, hysterectomy)
Neonatal outcomes (delivery gestation, birth weight, Apgar scores, neonatal intensive care unit admission, perinatal mortality)
cohort: 419 women with placenta previa and no vaginal bleeding before 34 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: Outpatient care of patients with placenta previa and no vaginal bleeding prior to 34 weeks of pregnancy was associated with more emergency deliveries, but there was no major adverse effect on maternal and neonatal outcomes.
